paragraphs: The R350 uses the M272 — a 3.5‑litre V6 petrol engine, part of Mercedes' M272 family. It was fitted from 2006 to 2013 across the W251/V251 generation, powering this six‑seat MPV with a smooth, refined petrol V6. The R350 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every R350 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the R350 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
